jah-mason.name: Jah Mason
jah-mason.tagline: Roots singer and deejay from Manchester, Jamaica. On record since 1991.
bio: Jah Mason, born Andre Johnson in Manchester Parish, Jamaica, has been recording since 1991, when his first single came out under the name Perry Mason. Known to many as Fire Mason, he moves easily between singing and deejaying.

His catalogue runs to nearly twenty studio albums, among them Keep Your Joy and Working So Hard (2002), Wheat and Tears (2006, Greensleeves), Princess Gone... The Saga Bed (2006, VP) and Love & Wisdom (2015). He also cut The Pow Pow Trilogy (2008) together with Anthony B and Turbulence.
From early Jah Cure combinations on Henfield to his 2026 seven inch on Five Disciples Crew Records, his music has been pressed on vinyl by labels across Jamaica and Europe.
facts: Greensleeves, VP, Jah Warrior, Pow Pow, Kickin
jah-mason.credits: Photos: Krd, Ruhr Reggae Summer 2013, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ruhr_Reggae_Summer_2013_-_Jah_Mason_02.jpg)

de.tagline: Roots-Sänger und Deejay aus Manchester, Jamaika. Auf Platte seit 1991.
bio: Jah Mason, geboren als Andre Johnson im Manchester Parish auf Jamaika, nimmt seit 1991 auf. Damals erschien seine erste Single unter dem Namen Perry Mason. Viele kennen ihn als Fire Mason, und er wechselt mühelos zwischen Gesang und Deejaying.

Sein Katalog umfasst fast zwanzig Studioalben, darunter Keep Your Joy und Working So Hard (2002), Wheat and Tears (2006, Greensleeves), Princess Gone... The Saga Bed (2006, VP) und Love & Wisdom (2015). Mit Anthony B und Turbulence nahm er außerdem The Pow Pow Trilogy (2008) auf.
Von frühen Kombinationen mit Jah Cure auf Henfield bis zu seiner Seven Inch von 2026 auf Five Disciples Crew Records: Seine Musik wurde von Labels in Jamaika und Europa auf Vinyl gepresst.
facts: Greensleeves, VP, Jah Warrior, Pow Pow, Kickin

fr.tagline: Chanteur et deejay roots de Manchester, Jamaïque. Sur disque depuis 1991.
bio: Jah Mason, né Andre Johnson dans la paroisse de Manchester en Jamaïque, enregistre depuis 1991, année de son premier single sous le nom de Perry Mason. Connu de beaucoup sous le nom de Fire Mason, il passe avec aisance du chant au deejaying.

Son catalogue compte près de vingt albums studio, dont Keep Your Joy et Working So Hard (2002), Wheat and Tears (2006, Greensleeves), Princess Gone... The Saga Bed (2006, VP) et Love & Wisdom (2015). Il a aussi enregistré The Pow Pow Trilogy (2008) avec Anthony B et Turbulence.
Des premières combinaisons avec Jah Cure chez Henfield à son 45 tours de 2026 chez Five Disciples Crew Records, sa musique a été pressée sur vinyle par des labels de Jamaïque et d'Europe.
facts: Greensleeves, VP, Jah Warrior, Pow Pow, Kickin

es.tagline: Cantante y deejay de roots desde Manchester, Jamaica. Grabando desde 1991.
bio: Jah Mason, nacido Andre Johnson en la parroquia de Manchester, Jamaica, graba desde 1991, cuando salió su primer single bajo el nombre de Perry Mason. Muchos lo conocen como Fire Mason y pasa con naturalidad del canto al deejaying.

Su catálogo suma casi veinte álbumes de estudio, entre ellos Keep Your Joy y Working So Hard (2002), Wheat and Tears (2006, Greensleeves), Princess Gone... The Saga Bed (2006, VP) y Love & Wisdom (2015). También grabó The Pow Pow Trilogy (2008) junto a Anthony B y Turbulence.
Desde sus primeras combinaciones con Jah Cure en Henfield hasta su siete pulgadas de 2026 en Five Disciples Crew Records, su música ha sido editada en vinilo por sellos de Jamaica y Europa.
facts: Greensleeves, VP, Jah Warrior, Pow Pow, Kickin

pt.tagline: Cantor e deejay de roots de Manchester, Jamaica. Gravando desde 1991.
bio: Jah Mason, nascido Andre Johnson na paróquia de Manchester, Jamaica, grava desde 1991, quando saiu seu primeiro single com o nome Perry Mason. Conhecido por muitos como Fire Mason, ele transita com facilidade entre o canto e o deejaying.

Seu catálogo soma quase vinte álbuns de estúdio, entre eles Keep Your Joy e Working So Hard (2002), Wheat and Tears (2006, Greensleeves), Princess Gone... The Saga Bed (2006, VP) e Love & Wisdom (2015). Ele também gravou The Pow Pow Trilogy (2008) com Anthony B e Turbulence.
Das primeiras parcerias com Jah Cure na Henfield ao seu compacto de sete polegadas de 2026 pela Five Disciples Crew Records, sua música foi prensada em vinil por selos da Jamaica e da Europa.

lutan-fyah.name: Lutan Fyah
lutan-fyah.tagline: Roots reggae singer from Spanish Town, Jamaica. Strength and resilience since 1999.
bio: Lutan Fyah, born Anthony Martin in Spanish Town, Jamaica, studied architecture and played football for Constant Spring before music took over. He started recording in 1999 and has released a steady stream of roots reggae ever since.

His albums include Dem No Know Demself (2004), Time & Place (2005), Phantom War (2006, Greensleeves), Healthy Lifestyle (2006, VP), Life of a King (2013), Longest Liva (2019) and Strength & Resilience (2025, I Grade Records).
On vinyl he has voiced riddims for Xterminator, Silly Walks, Irie Ites, Oneness and many more, alongside artists such as Luciano, Anthony B, Turbulence and Morgan Heritage.
releases: Keep On Trying (with Anthony B, Dubmatix)
lutan-fyah.credits: Photos: Peter Verwimp (CC0); reggae unite blog (CC BY-SA 3.0); Ngilozi (CC BY-SA 3.0); via Wikimedia Commons

Zu seinen Alben gehören Dem No Know Demself (2004), Time & Place (2005), Phantom War (2006, Greensleeves), Healthy Lifestyle (2006, VP), Life of a King (2013), Longest Liva (2019) und Strength & Resilience (2025, I Grade Records).
Auf Vinyl sang er Riddims für Xterminator, Silly Walks, Irie Ites, Oneness und viele mehr, an der Seite von Künstlern wie Luciano, Anthony B, Turbulence und Morgan Heritage.

glen-washington.name: Glen Washington
glen-washington.tagline: Soulful roots and lovers rock from May Pen, Jamaica. A voice that has carried reggae for five decades.
bio: Glen Washington, born Glenroy Washington in 1957, grew up in May Pen, Jamaica. He started out as a drummer and singer and cut his first record, "Rockers Nu Crackers", in the late 1970s.
For years he worked mostly behind the scenes as a musician and producer. In 1998 "Kindness For Weakness" brought him back to the charts and started one of the most consistent careers in roots reggae.

Since then he has released more than 20 albums for Studio One, VP Records, Joe Fraser, Zion High Productions, Love Injection and Tad's Record. His husky, soulful voice moves easily between conscious roots and lovers rock. His latest album is Just Giving Thanks (2025).
releases: No More Will I Roam Riddim
glen-washington.credits: Photos: Thomas Euler (CC BY-SA 2.0), Ruhr Reggae Summer 2009, via Wikimedia Commons

de.tagline: Gefühlvoller Roots- und Lovers-Rock aus May Pen, Jamaika. Eine Stimme, die den Reggae seit fünf Jahrzehnten prägt.
bio: Glen Washington, geboren 1957 als Glenroy Washington, wuchs in May Pen, Jamaika, auf. Er begann als Schlagzeuger und Sänger und nahm Ende der 1970er Jahre seine erste Platte auf: "Rockers Nu Crackers".

Viele Jahre arbeitete er vor allem im Hintergrund, als Musiker und Produzent. 1998 brachte ihn "Kindness For Weakness" zurück in die Charts. Damit begann eine der beständigsten Karrieren im Roots Reggae.

Seitdem hat er mehr als 20 Alben veröffentlicht, bei Studio One, VP Records, Joe Fraser, Zion High Productions, Love Injection und Tad's Record. Seine raue, soulige Stimme bewegt sich mühelos zwischen Conscious Roots und Lovers Rock. Sein neuestes Album ist Just Giving Thanks (2025).

fr.tagline: Du roots et du lovers rock plein d'âme, venus de May Pen, en Jamaïque. Une voix qui porte le reggae depuis cinq décennies.
bio: Glen Washington, né Glenroy Washington en 1957, a grandi à May Pen, en Jamaïque. Il a commencé comme batteur et chanteur et a enregistré son premier disque, « Rockers Nu Crackers », à la fin des années 1970.

Pendant des années, il a surtout travaillé dans l'ombre, comme musicien et producteur. En 1998, « Kindness For Weakness » l'a ramené dans les classements et a lancé l'une des carrières les plus régulières du roots reggae.

Depuis, il a sorti plus de 20 albums chez Studio One, VP Records, Joe Fraser, Zion High Productions, Love Injection et Tad's Record. Sa voix rauque et soul passe sans effort du roots conscient au lovers rock. Son dernier album est Just Giving Thanks (2025).
facts: De la fin des années 1970 à aujourd'hui

es.tagline: Roots con alma y lovers rock desde May Pen, Jamaica. Una voz que lleva el reggae desde hace cinco décadas.
bio: Glen Washington, nacido Glenroy Washington en 1957, creció en May Pen, Jamaica. Empezó como batería y cantante y grabó su primer disco, "Rockers Nu Crackers", a finales de los años setenta.
Durante años trabajó sobre todo entre bastidores como músico y productor. En 1998 "Kindness For Weakness" lo devolvió a las listas y abrió una de las carreras más constantes del roots reggae.

Desde entonces ha publicado más de 20 álbumes para Studio One, VP Records, Joe Fraser, Zion High Productions, Love Injection y Tad's Record. Su voz ronca y llena de soul pasa con facilidad del roots consciente al lovers rock. Su último álbum es Just Giving Thanks (2025).

pt.tagline: Roots cheio de alma e lovers rock de May Pen, Jamaica. Uma voz que carrega o reggae há cinco décadas.
bio: Glen Washington, nascido Glenroy Washington em 1957, cresceu em May Pen, Jamaica. Começou como baterista e cantor e gravou seu primeiro disco, "Rockers Nu Crackers", no fim dos anos 1970.

Por muitos anos trabalhou principalmente nos bastidores, como músico e produtor. Em 1998, "Kindness For Weakness" o levou de volta às paradas e iniciou uma das carreiras mais constantes do roots reggae.

Desde então lançou mais de 20 álbuns pela Studio One, VP Records, Joe Fraser, Zion High Productions, Love Injection e Tad's Record. Sua voz rouca e cheia de soul transita com facilidade entre o roots consciente e o lovers rock. Seu álbum mais recente é Just Giving Thanks (2025).
facts: Do fim dos anos 70 até hoje

natural-black.name: Natural Black
natural-black.tagline: Conscious roots reggae with a smooth, mellow voice. From Georgetown, Guyana, to the heart of Jamaican music.
bio: Natural Black was born Mortimer Softley in Georgetown, Guyana, in 1975. In 1995 he moved to Jamaica to follow his dream of becoming a reggae singer. He worked as a welder and a coffee picker and recorded in his spare time.

His breakthrough came in the early 2000s with producer Roger Grant and the singles "With Feeling" and "Bad Mind". Shows at Sting, Reggae Sumfest and Rebel Salute followed, and tours through France, Switzerland and Sweden.

In 2006 "Far From Reality" for Don Corleon went to the top of the charts. His albums include Spiritual Food and World War. Today he is known far beyond Jamaica for his smooth voice and conscious lyrics.
releases: As The World Turns (feat. Mark Wonder)
natural-black.credits: Images: stills from the artist's official music videos on YouTube. Preview only, to be replaced by press photos

de.tagline: Bewusster Roots Reggae mit sanfter, warmer Stimme. Von Georgetown in Guyana mitten ins Herz der jamaikanischen Musik.
bio: Natural Black wurde 1975 als Mortimer Softley in Georgetown, Guyana, geboren. 1995 zog er nach Jamaika, um Reggae-Sänger zu werden. Er arbeitete als Schweißer und Kaffeepflücker und nahm in seiner freien Zeit Songs auf.

Der Durchbruch kam Anfang der 2000er mit Produzent Roger Grant und den Singles "With Feeling" und "Bad Mind". Es folgten Auftritte bei Sting, Reggae Sumfest und Rebel Salute und Tourneen durch Frankreich, die Schweiz und Schweden.

2006 kam "Far From Reality" für Don Corleon an die Spitze der Charts. Zu seinen Alben gehören Spiritual Food und World War. Heute kennt man ihn weit über Jamaika hinaus für seine sanfte Stimme und seine bewussten Texte.

fr.tagline: Du roots reggae conscient porté par une voix douce et chaleureuse. De Georgetown, au Guyana, jusqu'au cœur de la musique jamaïcaine.
bio: Natural Black est né Mortimer Softley en 1975 à Georgetown, au Guyana. En 1995, il s'installe en Jamaïque pour devenir chanteur de reggae. Il travaille comme soudeur et cueilleur de café et enregistre pendant son temps libre.

La percée arrive au début des années 2000 avec le producteur Roger Grant et les singles « With Feeling » et « Bad Mind ». Suivent des concerts à Sting, Reggae Sumfest et Rebel Salute, et des tournées en France, en Suisse et en Suède.

En 2006, « Far From Reality » pour Don Corleon atteint le sommet des charts. Parmi ses albums figurent Spiritual Food et World War. Aujourd'hui, on le connaît bien au-delà de la Jamaïque pour sa voix douce et ses textes conscients.

es.tagline: Roots reggae consciente con una voz suave y cálida. De Georgetown, Guyana, al corazón de la música jamaicana.
bio: Natural Black nació como Mortimer Softley en Georgetown, Guyana, en 1975. En 1995 se mudó a Jamaica para cumplir su sueño de ser cantante de reggae. Trabajó como soldador y recolector de café y grababa en su tiempo libre.

Su gran salto llegó a principios de los 2000 con el productor Roger Grant y los singles "With Feeling" y "Bad Mind". Siguieron actuaciones en Sting, Reggae Sumfest y Rebel Salute, y giras por Francia, Suiza y Suecia.

En 2006 "Far From Reality" para Don Corleon llegó a lo más alto de las listas. Entre sus álbumes están Spiritual Food y World War. Hoy es conocido mucho más allá de Jamaica por su voz suave y sus letras conscientes.

pt.tagline: Roots reggae consciente com uma voz suave e calorosa. De Georgetown, Guiana, ao coração da música jamaicana.
bio: Natural Black nasceu Mortimer Softley em Georgetown, Guiana, em 1975. Em 1995 mudou-se para a Jamaica para realizar o sonho de ser cantor de reggae. Trabalhou como soldador e colhedor de café e gravava nas horas vagas.

A grande virada veio no início dos anos 2000 com o produtor Roger Grant e os singles "With Feeling" e "Bad Mind". Vieram shows no Sting, Reggae Sumfest e Rebel Salute, e turnês pela França, Suíça e Suécia.

Em 2006, "Far From Reality" para Don Corleon chegou ao topo das paradas. Entre seus álbuns estão Spiritual Food e World War. Hoje ele é conhecido muito além da Jamaica pela voz suave e pelas letras conscientes.

ras-shiloh.name: Ras Shiloh
ras-shiloh.tagline: Rastafari roots reggae, carried by a clear and soaring tenor voice.
bio: Ras Shiloh was born Thomas Williams in Brooklyn, New York, in 1975. He grew up with the music of the Jamaican diaspora and found his calling in roots reggae and the Rastafari faith.

His first album Chants came out in 1997. From Rasta To You (2002) and Coming Home (2007) on VP Records and Only King Selassie (2007) on Greensleeves made his name known worldwide. For more than 25 years his clear tenor has carried a message of faith, unity and love.
He has recorded for Penthouse, Maximum Sound, Firehouse Crew and No Doubt, and he still releases new music, most recently the single "Think" (2025).
facts: From Rasta To You, Coming Home, Only King Selassie
ras-shiloh.credits: Images: stills from the artist's official music videos on YouTube. Preview only, to be replaced by press photos. Portrait: comechatwidmi (CC BY 3.0) via Wikimedia Commons

Er hat für Penthouse, Maximum Sound, Firehouse Crew und No Doubt aufgenommen und veröffentlicht bis heute neue Musik, zuletzt die Single "Think" (2025).

facts: From Rasta To You, Coming Home, Only King Selassie

bugle.name: Bugle
bugle.tagline: Anointed. Dancehall and reggae from Portland, Jamaica, with a message in every song.
bio: Bugle was born Roy Thompson in Portland, Jamaica. He started writing songs in primary school and got his first real chance in 2000, when he began writing for and touring with Elephant Man.

After five years on the road, from the Caribbean to the USA, Canada and Japan, he went solo. With the production team Daseca he found his own sound on songs like "Journeys", "Anointed" and "Nuh Compatible".

Today Bugle is one of the most respected voices in modern Jamaican music, with more than 500 releases. His single "Thank You Lord" with Buju Banton and Damian "Jr. Gong" Marley has been watched more than 14 million times.
releases: Thank You Lord (feat. Buju Banton, Damian Marley)
bugle.credits: Images: stills from the artist's official music videos on YouTube. Preview only, to be replaced by press photos

bio: Bugle wurde als Roy Thompson in Portland, Jamaika, geboren. Er schrieb schon in der Grundschule Songs. Seine erste echte Chance kam im Jahr 2000, als er begann, für Elephant Man zu schreiben und mit ihm zu touren.

Nach fünf Jahren auf Tour, von der Karibik über die USA und Kanada bis nach Japan, startete er solo. Mit dem Produktionsteam Daseca fand er seinen eigenen Sound, mit Songs wie "Journeys", "Anointed" und "Nuh Compatible".

Heute gehört Bugle mit mehr als 500 Veröffentlichungen zu den angesehensten Stimmen der modernen jamaikanischen Musik. Seine Single "Thank You Lord" mit Buju Banton und Damian "Jr. Gong" Marley wurde mehr als 14 Millionen Mal angesehen.

fr.tagline: Anointed. Du dancehall et du reggae de Portland, en Jamaïque, avec un message dans chaque chanson.

Après cinq ans sur la route, des Caraïbes aux États-Unis, au Canada et au Japon, il se lance en solo. Avec l'équipe de production Daseca, il trouve son propre son, sur des titres comme « Journeys », « Anointed » et « Nuh Compatible ».

Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 500 sorties, Bugle est l'une des voix les plus respectées de la musique jamaïcaine moderne. Son single « Thank You Lord » avec Buju Banton et Damian « Jr. Gong » Marley a été vu plus de 14 millions de fois.

es.tagline: Anointed. Dancehall y reggae desde Portland, Jamaica, con un mensaje en cada canción.
bio: Bugle nació como Roy Thompson en Portland, Jamaica. Empezó a escribir canciones en la escuela primaria y tuvo su primera gran oportunidad en 2000, cuando comenzó a escribir para Elephant Man y a salir de gira con él.

Tras cinco años en la carretera, del Caribe a Estados Unidos, Canadá y Japón, se lanzó en solitario. Con el equipo de producción Daseca encontró su propio sonido en canciones como "Journeys", "Anointed" y "Nuh Compatible".

Hoy Bugle es una de las voces más respetadas de la música jamaicana moderna, con más de 500 lanzamientos. Su single "Thank You Lord" con Buju Banton y Damian "Jr. Gong" Marley se ha visto más de 14 millones de veces.

pt.tagline: Anointed. Dancehall e reggae de Portland, Jamaica, com uma mensagem em cada música.
bio: Bugle nasceu Roy Thompson em Portland, Jamaica. Começou a escrever canções ainda no ensino fundamental e teve sua primeira grande chance em 2000, quando passou a compor para Elephant Man e a sair em turnê com ele.

Depois de cinco anos na estrada, do Caribe aos Estados Unidos, Canadá e Japão, seguiu carreira solo. Com a equipe de produção Daseca encontrou seu próprio som em músicas como "Journeys", "Anointed" e "Nuh Compatible".

Hoje Bugle é uma das vozes mais respeitadas da música jamaicana moderna, com mais de 500 lançamentos. Seu single "Thank You Lord" com Buju Banton e Damian "Jr. Gong" Marley já foi visto mais de 14 milhões de vezes.

natty-king.name: Natty King
natty-king.tagline: Roots reggae from St. Thomas, Jamaica. The voice behind "No Guns To Town" and "Mr. Greedy".
bio: Natty King was born Kevin Christopher Roberts in 1977 and grew up in the countryside of St. Thomas, in the southeast of Jamaica. His heroes are The Wailers, Burning Spear and Luciano.

In the early 2000s "Mr. Greedy" and "No Guns To Town" went to number one in Jamaica, on the charts and on the video charts. In 2003 he won Best New Entertainer at the IRAWMA awards in New York. He has played Sting, Rebel Salute, Reggae Sumfest and Rototom Sunsplash.
His albums include No Guns To Town (2003), Born To Be Free (2010) and Rebellution (2022). His songs speak about faith, the environment and the youths.
natty-king.credits: Images: stills from the artist's official music videos on YouTube. Preview only, to be replaced by press photos

de.tagline: Roots Reggae aus St. Thomas, Jamaika. Die Stimme hinter "No Guns To Town" und "Mr. Greedy".
bio: Natty King wurde 1977 als Kevin Christopher Roberts geboren und wuchs auf dem Land in St. Thomas im Südosten Jamaikas auf. Seine Vorbilder sind The Wailers, Burning Spear und Luciano.

Anfang der 2000er standen "Mr. Greedy" und "No Guns To Town" in Jamaika auf Platz eins, in den Charts und in den Video-Charts. 2003 gewann er bei den IRAWMA Awards in New York den Preis als bester neuer Künstler. Er spielte bei Sting, Rebel Salute, Reggae Sumfest und Rototom Sunsplash.
Zu seinen Alben gehören No Guns To Town (2003), Born To Be Free (2010) und Rebellution (2022). Seine Songs handeln von Glauben, Umwelt und der Jugend.

fr.tagline: Du roots reggae de St. Thomas, en Jamaïque. La voix derrière « No Guns To Town » et « Mr. Greedy ».
bio: Natty King est né Kevin Christopher Roberts en 1977 et a grandi à la campagne, à St. Thomas, dans le sud-est de la Jamaïque. Ses modèles sont The Wailers, Burning Spear et Luciano.

Au début des années 2000, « Mr. Greedy » et « No Guns To Town » atteignent la première place en Jamaïque, dans les charts comme dans les classements vidéo. En 2003, il reçoit le prix de la meilleure révélation aux IRAWMA à New York. Il s'est produit à Sting, Rebel Salute, Reggae Sumfest et Rototom Sunsplash.
Parmi ses albums figurent No Guns To Town (2003), Born To Be Free (2010) et Rebellution (2022). Ses chansons parlent de foi, d'environnement et de la jeunesse.
facts: Du début des années 2000 à aujourd'hui

es.tagline: Roots reggae desde St. Thomas, Jamaica. La voz detrás de "No Guns To Town" y "Mr. Greedy".

A principios de los 2000, "Mr. Greedy" y "No Guns To Town" llegaron al número uno en Jamaica, en las listas y en las listas de vídeos. En 2003 ganó el premio a Mejor Nuevo Artista en los IRAWMA de Nueva York. Ha actuado en Sting, Rebel Salute, Reggae Sumfest y Rototom Sunsplash.
Entre sus álbumes están No Guns To Town (2003), Born To Be Free (2010) y Rebellution (2022). Sus canciones hablan de fe, del medio ambiente y de la juventud.

chuck-fenda.name: Chuck Fenda
chuck-fenda.tagline: Conscious reggae from Brooklyn and Jamaica. The Living Fire behind "Warning" and "Gash Dem".
bio: Chuck Fenda was born Leshorn Dalton Whitehead on 15 June 1972 in Brooklyn, New York, and grew up between New York and Jamaica. Fans know him as "The Living Fire" and the "Poor People Defender".

He started out in the late 1990s with King Jammy and then joined the Fifth Element camp. The albums Better Days (2004), The Living Fire (2007), Fulfillment (2009) and Jah Elements (2013) followed. His song "All About Da Weed" is on the soundtrack of Grand Theft Auto IV, and "Warning" has more than six million plays on Spotify.

He calls his music conscious reggae. In summer 2026 he headlined the sold-out Lakesplash Festival in Switzerland and played the Turnpike Reggae Festival in Germany. New singles such as "Wah Gwaan Pon Di Rock" and "Take Time" keep coming.

turbulence.name: Turbulence
turbulence.tagline: Jamaican singjay between conscious reggae and dancehall. The unique voice behind "Notorious" and "Celebration of Life".
bio: Turbulence was born Sheldon Campbell on 11 January 1980 in Jamaica. In 1999 the producer Philip "Fatis" Burrell discovered him, and his first album Rising followed in 2001.

His breakthrough came with "Notorious" on the Scallawah riddim. In 2005 the song went to number one on reggae charts in Jamaica, New York, London, Toronto and Japan. Since then he has released more than 20 albums, from Songs of Solomon and Notorious to Celebration of Life (2012) and The Remedy (2021). He also appears in the award-winning documentary Rise Up (2007).

His music comes from old-school roots, inspired by Beres Hammond, Cocoa Tea, Sizzla and Luciano. In 2025 he toured Africa, the Bahamas and Guadeloupe, and in 2026 he released new singles such as "Rasta Nah Surrender".

junior-kelly.name: Junior Kelly
junior-kelly.tagline: Conscious reggae from Kingston, Jamaica. The voice behind "If Love So Nice" and the new album "Care About Me".
bio: Junior Kelly was born Keith Morgan on 23 September 1969 in Kingston, Jamaica. He is the younger brother of the deejay Jim Kelly and made his first recording in 1985.

His breakthrough came in 1999 with "If Love So Nice", which became a hit in Jamaica and around the world. The albums Rise (2000), Love So Nice (2001) with the hit "Boom Draw", Smile (2003) and Tough Life (2005) followed. Red Pond (2010) features Ras Shiloh, Lukie D and Queen Ifrica, and Urban Poet (2015) took him on tour through Europe and the Caribbean.
He is still writing and recording: "Protection" (2024), "Everything" (2025) and "Perseverance" with Torch (2026) came out as videos, and in 2026 he released his new album Care About Me.

everton-blender.name: Everton Blender
everton-blender.tagline: Roots reggae with a smooth tenor from Clarendon, Jamaica. The voice behind "Lift Up Your Head" and "Ghetto People Song".
bio: Everton Blender was born Everton Dennis Williams on 21 November 1954 in Clarendon, Jamaica, and grew up on Maxfield Avenue in Kingston. In the late 1970s he won a talent contest at the Bohemia Club and sang on sound systems such as Destiny Outernational.

In the early 1990s Garnett Silk introduced him to the producer Richard Bell. "We No Jus' a Come" became a hit in Jamaica, and his first album Lift Up Your Head reached number four on the UK Black Echoes chart. Together with Garnett Silk and Luciano he stood for the return of conscious reggae in the 1990s, and with his own label Blend Dem Productions he also produced other artists.
He has never stopped: in 2024 he released the album Can't Take My Space, and new videos such as "Slavery Ship" and "Fools Illusion" keep coming.

chezidek.name: Chezidek
chezidek.tagline: Roots reggae from St. Ann, Jamaica. The voice behind "Leave De Trees", "Call Pon Dem" and "All My Life".
bio: Chezidek was born Desbert Johnson in 1973 in St. Ann, Jamaica. He sang at school concerts and in the St. Ann's Bay Marching Band, and later performed on local sound systems as Chilla Rinch.

In Kingston he linked up with the producer Philip "Fatis" Burrell, and in 2002 his first album Harvest Time came out on VP Records. "Leave De Trees" went into the BBC dancehall top 10, and "Call Pon Dem" from the album Inna Di Road (2007) is part of the Grand Theft Auto IV soundtrack. His video "All My Life" has more than 40 million views.
He has played Rebel Salute, Sting and stages across Europe and Africa. In 2026 he released his new album Marijuana Prayer.

norris-man.name: Norris Man
norris-man.tagline: Roots reggae from Trenchtown, Kingston. The voice behind "Persistence" and the new album "Winner".
bio: Norris Man was born Christopher Campbell and grew up in Trenchtown and Arnett Gardens in Kingston, Jamaica, with Bob Marley as his hometown hero. He got his name from his love of karate and Chuck Norris. As a ten-year-old, older sound men lifted him onto a box and handed him the mic.

He recorded at Black Scorpio, Leggo and Celestial Sounds and, after turning to Rastafari in the mid-1990s, at Buju Banton's Cell Block studio. With the producer Richard "Bello" Bell he made the album Persistence (2000) with the anthems "Persistence", "Hold On To Your Faith" and "Bad Road". He performed "Persistence" at Sting 98.

Since then he has released more than 15 albums, from Ghetto Life (2012) to Deep Conversations (2022) and LIFE (2023). In 2024 he played Reggae Sumfest, in February 2026 he released the album Winner, and in November 2026 the single "Struggling" with Irie Ites and Naram.

yami-bolo.name: Yami Bolo
yami-bolo.tagline: Roots and culture from Kingston 13, Jamaica. Sugar Minott's youth, Augustus Pablo's voice, and "Still Searching" with Damian Marley.
bio: Yami Bolo was born Rolando Ephraim McLean on 1 October 1970 in Kingston, Jamaica, and grew up in Kingston 13. He started singing in church and joined Sugar Minott's Youth Promotion crew as a teenager. His first singles came out in 1986.

In the late 1980s and early 1990s he recorded for Augustus Pablo's Rockers International, with songs like "Struggle In Babylon", followed by the albums He Who Knows It, Feels It (1991) and Up Life Street (1992) on Heartbeat. In 1994 his album Love Is Dangerous with the Japanese singer Miya sold 500,000 copies in Japan. He sings on "Still Searching" from Damian Marley's Halfway Tree, the 2002 Grammy winner for Best Reggae Album.

His songs speak about faith, Rastafari and justice, from "Blood Diamonds" (2008) to "Bloody Coltan" (2011). His own label Yam Euphony released the album Jah Love Will Rule the World in 2021, followed by Cool and Easy in 2024.
